item.title: A study of long-context retrieval failures
item.content:encoded:
Researchers measured retrieval accuracy across context windows of 8k, 128k and 1M tokens, and found a consistent drop past the 128k mark on multi-hop questions.

The full article body arrives in the feed, so no second HTTP request is needed to summarize it. That is the whole reason content_in_feed exists for this source.
